q.description: search canonical names or aliases, at most 120 characters

scope.description: '' for the public catalogue, or 'mine' for the caller's own works including drafts

status.description: work status filter, only meaningful with scope=mine

creator_id.description: restrict to one creator's published works (scope='' only)

keyword.description: case-insensitive title search; own shelf also searches summary

tag.description: restrict to works carrying one tag slug

game.description: canonical game slug, name or alias, at most 120 characters
